housing.summary: Numbeo's 1 August 2026 city table reports EUR 920.36 for a one-bedroom apartment in Antwerp city centre (https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/prices_by_city.jsp?displayCurrency=EUR&itemId=26). The Vlaams Woninghuurdecreet of 9 November 2018 sets the rental guarantee for dwellings in the Flemish Region (which includes Antwerp) at a maximum of three months' rent, in force since 1 January 2019 (https://codex.vlaanderen.be/PrintDocument.ashx?id=1029963&datum=&geannoteerd=false&print=false). Immoweb has a dedicated Antwerp apartment-rental search (https://www.immoweb.be/en/search/apartment/for-rent/antwerp/2000).

banking.summary: KBC's official expat account page says people settling in Flanders should use KBC and that applicants arriving in Belgium must bring an ID card and residence permit to the branch to sign for and collect the debit card (https://www.kbcbrussels.be/retail/en/products/payments/current-accounts/open-plus-account-for-expats.html).

schools.summary: Antwerp International School offers the International Baccalaureate PYP, MYP and DP (https://ais-antwerp.be/learning/curriculum/). Owl Academy in Antwerp teaches the British National Curriculum (https://owl-academy.com/curricula/elementary-school/). The University of Antwerp's schools page lists Antwerp international schools and links to the city's school finder (https://www.uantwerpen.be/en/jobs/international-staff-office/preparation/family-matters/schools/).

legal_admin.summary: Antwerp's official page says its Loket Migratie helps newcomers register their stay and works by appointment (https://www.antwerpen.be/registratie-en-verblijf-niet-belg).
legal_admin.registration_step: Book an appointment with Antwerp Loket Migratie to register the newcomer's stay.

tax_finance.summary: Belgium uses the National Register Number, or BIS Register Number where applicable, as the relevant individual identifier. The National Register number is assigned automatically when a person's base record is entered (https://www.ibz.rrn.fgov.be/sites/default/files/documents/nl/rijksregister/onderrichtingen/IT-lijst/IT000_Rijksregisternummer.pdf). For an eligible foreign person using ForReg who has neither number, the FPS Finance processing officer creates one (https://finance.belgium.be/sites/default/files/E-services/FORREG/FORREG_Userguide_EN_V1.pdf); ForReg eligibility and steps are described at https://finance.belgium.be/en/E-services/forreg.
tax_finance.tax_id_name: National Register Number / BIS Register Number

transport.summary: An Antwerp city decision identifies De Lijn as the Flemish public-transport operator serving Antwerp (https://ebesluit.antwerpen.be/zittingen/23.0926.3894.4548/agendapunten/24.0729.9975.6708). De Lijn's adult Omnipas costs EUR 62 for one month, plus a EUR 10 MOBIB-card administration fee (https://www.delijn.be/en/content/vervoerbewijzen/abonnementen/omnipas/).
transport.driving_licence_exchange: Apply through the driving-licence service of the municipality where registered. A valid EU/EEA licence generally remains usable while valid, subject to listed exchange triggers. During the first 185 registration days, a recognized non-EU licence may be used; exchange may start during that period, but the Belgian licence is issued only after 185 days and only if the official conditions are met (https://mobilit.belgium.be/nl/weg/rijden/rijbewijzen/buitenlands-rijbewijs).
transport.healthcare_registration: Join a Belgian health-insurance fund (ziekenfonds/mutuality) or the public HZIV; membership is required for compulsory-insurance healthcare benefits (https://www.riziv.fgov.be/nl/thema-s/verzorging-kosten-en-terugbetaling/verzekerbaarheid/aansluiten-bij-een-ziekenfonds).
